articles.title: Fed Meeting, Mag-7 Earnings: What to Watch This Week
articles.mainIdea: Fed Meeting, Mag-7 Earnings: What to Watch This Week
articles.summary: The Wall Street Journal: Fed Meeting, Mag-7 Earnings: What to Watch This Week. The Magnificent 7 tech stocks will play a starring role on a busy Wednesday, with Amazon, Microsoft, Meta Platforms and Alphabet due up this afternoon, followed by Apple on Thursday. The Federal Reserve is also expected to hold interest rates steady Wednesday in what will likely be Jerome Powell’s final meeting as Fed chair. Related tickers mentioned: AAPL, AMZN, GOOG, META, MSFT.
